relationships.subject: circKcnk9
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, circKcnk9 was found to act as a miR-124-3p sponge.

relationships.subject: miR-124-3p
relationships.evidence_quote: the signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3), validated as a target of miR-124-3p, could play a critical role in visceral hypersensitivity by regulating NSF/GluR2

relationships.subject: circKcnk9
relationships.evidence_quote: whereas overexpression of spinal circKcnk9 induced visceral hypersensitivity and increased c-Fos expression in control rats

key_findings: Spinal circKcnk9 is increased in IBS-like rats and promotes visceral hypersensitivity as a miR-124-3p sponge via STAT3/NSF/GluR2.
